_comment: Pre-built pmapper-style IAM graph for the the target account escalation scenario. Committed as seed data — no real credentials.
_format: Simplified pmapper graph JSON. Nodes = principals, edges = permission-composition relationships.

edges.reason: dev-alice has sts:AssumeRole on LambdaRole and is listed in its trust policy
LambdaRole has iam:PassRole/* and lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration/*. An attacker can update an existing Lambda's execution role to AdminRole, then invoke the Lambda to execute as admin.

hops.note: Direct trust — dev-alice is an explicit principal in the trust policy
Update a Lambda's execution role to AdminRole; invocation then runs as admin

minimum_cut_set.description: Remove the dev-alice principal from LambdaRole's trust policy, OR scope iam:PassRole on LambdaRole to only pass LambdaRole itself (not AdminRole).

cheapest_fix.result: LambdaRole can no longer pass AdminRole to a Lambda function — edge 2 is broken.
